name: Michael Gahler - § 27/1
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Ukraine
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘while’ and ‘enlargement constitutes a mutually beneficial geostrategic investment in peace, stability and security on the European continent as well as a moral obligation; stresses, therefore, that Ukraine’s future lies in the EU and recognises Ukraine’s European integration as a strategic priority for the Union;’
